tickets.title: Open and Prepare New Account
tickets.text: Use this workflow to prepare, submit, and confirm a new Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz account opening package. Confirm account purpose, registration type, funding path, required disclosures, and operational readiness before considering the account complete. The new account is a joint taxable advisory account with transfer-on-death registration, a moderate-growth objective, tax sensitivity, and a preference to avoid adding to the existing Paper Otter Analytics concentration; funding will come from cash above the $120,000 household reserve target and anticipated estate cash once received.

subTasks.title: Confirm account profile and registration
subTasks.text: Verify the intended account type (joint taxable advisory), ownership or registration (joint with transfer-on-death), tax classification if applicable, investment objective (moderate-growth), risk tolerance, and any special restrictions (avoid adding to the existing Paper Otter Analytics concentration) before paperwork is prepared.

subTasks.title: Prepare and review account documents
subTasks.text: Complete the custodian or platform forms, advisory agreement items, fee schedule references, beneficiary fields if applicable, and required disclosures. Review for missing signatures, inconsistent addresses, and incomplete identity information.

subTasks.title: Submit opening package and track approval
subTasks.text: Submit the account package through the appropriate channel and monitor for approval, rejection, or additional information requests. Record any follow-up items in the client record.

subTasks.title: Confirm funding and first operational setup
subTasks.text: Confirm funding instructions, transfer status, cash availability (cash above the $120,000 household reserve target plus anticipated estate cash once received), model or allocation setup, statement delivery preference, and online access readiness before closing the workflow.

tickets.evidence: They agreed to proceed with the account-opening work by 2024-11-01.

tickets.text: Prepare a year-end tax projection for Nolan and Lila Pebblefizz that coordinates withholding, estimated tax exposure, appreciated-share giving, and a recommendation on whether to make a larger charitable gift before year-end, given higher household income from Nolan's Paper Otter Analytics equity vesting, Lila's new Moonbadger Design Studio wages, and their roughly $18,000 annual charitable giving including recurring support to Silver Marmot Arts Fund.

tickets.title: Gather Inheritance Intake Details
tickets.text: Collect the core facts needed to evaluate the inheritance from Adele Pebblefizz's estate for Nolan Pebblefizz, including the expected asset types (approximately $220,000 in cash plus a fractional inherited IRA interest), estimated timing, estate contact information, beneficiary status, tax documents expected, and any immediate cash flow or investment implications. Do not request sensitive account numbers unless required through secure channels.
